root_cause.text: The netfilter `nft_ct` module fails to drop pending enqueued packets in `nfqueue` when destroying conntrack templates, timeout policies, or helpers, allowing enqueued packets to retain stale references to these freed objects.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(ctx->net)` to `__nft_ct_set_destroy` (under the `NFT_CT_ZONE` case), `nft_ct_timeout_obj_destroy`, and `nft_ct_helper_obj_destroy` to force-drop enqueued packets before these conntrack objects are freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Include internal Netfilter header to expose required internal declarations.
intent_record.what: Added the local header file inclusion '#include "nf_internals.h"' to the include section.
intent_record.how: Provides the source file with access to internal Netfilter declarations and functions defined in 'nf_internals.h', resolving potential compilation errors or enabling the use of internal APIs.

intent_record.intent_summary: Drop queued netfilter hook packets when destroying a connection tracking zone to prevent use-after-free issues.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(ctx->net) within the NFT_CT_ZONE case of the __nft_ct_set_destroy function.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any queued packets associated with the netfilter hooks are dropped when the connection tracking zone is destroyed, preventing pending packets from referencing freed resources.

intent_record.intent_summary: Drop queued packets before destroying connection tracking timeout objects to prevent use-after-free errors.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(ctx->net) inside the nft_ct_timeout_obj_destroy function prior to releasing the timeout object.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any packets currently queued in the netfilter queue for the network namespace are dropped, preventing potential use-after-free issues when the timeout object is freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Drop queued packets when destroying a connection tracking helper object to prevent potential use-after-free issues.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(ctx->net) at the start of the nft_ct_helper_obj_destroy function.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any packets currently queued in the netfilter queue for the associated network namespace are dropped before the connection tracking helper object is released.
